jobs.title: AI transparency
jobs.description: Marketeam.ai Legal Product Integrations About Docs Resources Sign Up / Log In Legal AI Transparency How Marketeam.ai uses AI, and what to expect from it We are committed to being transparent about how artificial intelligence (AI) is used within our platform. This page explains which AI services we use, how they are applied, and what users should expect when interacting with AI-powered features. AI Services We Use Most features on our platform are powered by proprietary AI models hosted on our own infrastructure, which guarantees data isolation and prevents crossâcontamination between users or workloads. In addition, to provide our services, we use third-party AI technologies. â These include: Google's Gemini Models via Vertex AI Google's Veo Models via Vertex AI Google's Imagen Models via Vertex AI Anthropic's Claude Models via Vertex AI Anthropic's Claude Models via Anthropic API OpenAI's GPT Models via OpenAI's API These services process user inputs to generate outputs, automate functionality, and support core features of the platform. We use these providers only as needed to deliver our services. Their processing of data is governed by their respective terms and privacy policies. â How We Use AI AI is used to support and enhance our product experience. This may include: Generating and editing content Summarizing or analyzing information Automating workflows and repetitive tasks Providing suggestions, insights, or recommendations Powering user-facing assistance features â AI is used as a supportive tool and not as a substitute for human judgment. Human Oversight We design our systems to include human oversight where appropriate. Users are responsible for reviewing AI-generated outputs before relying on them, particularly for decisions involving financial,legal, medical, or other sensitive matters. â Limitations of AI AI systems are inherently probabilistic and may produce inaccurate or incomplete results. Outputs may: Contain errors or misleading information Reflect outdated or insufficient data Vary depending on input and context â You should not rely solely on AI-generated outputs without independent verification. â Data and Privacy We take reasonable measures to limit unnecessary data sharing and handle data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For more information, please refer to our Privacy Policy. We do not use user data to train AI models. â Responsible AI Use We are committed to using AI responsibly and in a way that aligns with the following principles: Safety Fairness Transparency Human control â Ongoing Improvements We continuously evaluate and improve how AI is used within our platform, including monitoring performance, updating safeguards, and adapting to evolving standards and expectations. â Contact If you have questions about our use of AI, or if you encounter incorrect, harmful, or unexpected behavior, please contact us.
